annotations.title: Find a brand in published measurements

description: Search ask10ais's published measurements (every public ranking and every scenario cell, asked in both Chinese and English) for a brand name. Returns its rank in each ranking and its mention rate with a 95% interval in each scenario, each with a link to the source page. Matching is a case-insensitive substring match plus registered aliases.

locale.description: Language for names, reading rules and citation templates: 'en' or 'zh'.

query.description: A brand or company name only, e.g. 'PETKIT' or '小佩'. Do not include personal information or conversation text.

name: find_brand
title: Find a brand in published measurements
